rationale: Turn 3 with Plains to play: three mana. The opponent is tapped out with one creature, A.I.M. Scientists 3/3. Web Up exiles it (then Ant-Man's Air Force attacks freely), or Quake develops a 3/3 on curve; both use the mana well. Depower now is a sorcery-speed -4/-0 with no combat to affect (full {2}{U} price, it is cheap only against an attacker), and passing wastes the turn.
